app.name: Riosoma
app.description: Watch, find, create, and update records in Riosoma.
connection.addressHelp: Enter the HTTPS address you open Riosoma at, without a path.
connection.tokenHelp: In Riosoma, open Settings, then Personal access tokens.  Create a token with Read tables, fields, and views and Read records.  To write records, also allow Add, change, and delete records.  Instant triggers also need Change tables, fields, and views and the Creator or Owner role.
input.pathHelp: Enter a path beginning with /api/v1, such as /api/v1/databases.  Set query parameters separately.
method.HEAD: HEAD
input.bodyHelp: Enter a JSON request body when the endpoint accepts one.
module.createDescription: Creates a record using the fields supplied.
module.updateDescription: Updates only the fields supplied for a record.
module.getDescription: Reads a record using its ID.
module.searchDescription: Finds up to 1,000 records with an exact text, numeric, or checkbox value.
module.apiDescription: Makes an authenticated call to a Riosoma /api/v1 path.
module.createdDescription: Watches records created in the selected table.
module.updatedDescription: Watches records updated in the selected table.
module.view: Watch New Records in a View
module.viewDescription: Watches newly created records that match the selected view when processed.
field.json: Enter a JSON value for this field.
error.address: Enter an HTTPS address without a path, query, username, or password.
error.input: Check the selected database, table, fields, and values.
error.path: Enter a path beginning with /api/v1 without a query, fragment, or relative path segments.
error.request: Riosoma could not complete the request.  Check the connection, permissions, and input.
error.cursor: Riosoma returned a repeated pagination cursor.
error.missing: The record is missing, is inaccessible, or does not match the selected view.
error.files: The app files are invalid.  Run the app build and tests.
error.environment: Set MAKE_API_TOKEN and a MAKE_ZONE such as us2.make.com.
error.arguments: Use deploy.mjs with no arguments to deploy, or with --check to validate offline.
error.deployment: Deployment failed.  Check the account, zone, scopes, and custom function access.
error.ambiguous: More than one matching app or component was found.  Check the account before deploying.
